seoTitle: TradingView Discount: How to Get 15% Off in Feb 2026
metaDescription: Learn where to find official TradingView discount codes, how to apply a 15% off promo, which plans qualify, and how to avoid expired offers.
intro: Subscribing to TradingView's Pro, Pro+, or Premium plans can get expensive over time, so grabbing a legitimate discount is worth the extra few minutes of research. This guide covers where to find official TradingView promo codes, how to apply a 15% off deal at checkout, and how to make sure your plan actually qualifies. It's aimed at anyone who wants premium features without paying full price.

steps.heading: Find where TradingView discounts are listed
steps.body: Check TradingView's official pricing page and any seasonal promotions for currently active discount codes.

steps.heading: Apply the promo code at checkout
steps.body: Enter the discount code during the checkout process for your chosen plan to apply the reduced pricing.

steps.heading: Check which plans are eligible
steps.body: Confirm whether the 15% off promo applies to Pro, Pro+, or Premium, since discounts can vary by plan tier.

steps.heading: Avoid expired codes
steps.body: Double-check the promo code's validity period before attempting to use it, since expired codes won't apply at checkout.

steps.heading: Watch official channels for future deals
steps.body: Keep an eye on TradingView's official announcements or email offers for additional discounts and limited-time promotions.

faq.question: Is the 15% off TradingView promo code always available?
faq.answer: Promo codes are typically time-limited, so availability can change, and it's worth checking the current offer directly on TradingView's site.

faq.question: Can I stack multiple discount codes together?
faq.answer: Most platforms, including TradingView, generally don't allow stacking multiple promo codes on a single purchase, so check the terms of any offer before assuming you can combine them.

faq.question: Does the discount apply to all subscription plans?
faq.answer: Eligibility can vary, so it's important to confirm whether a specific promo applies to Pro, Pro+, or Premium before checking out.

faq.question: What happens if my promo code doesn't work at checkout?
faq.answer: This usually means the code has expired or doesn't apply to your selected plan, so double-check both before trying again.
